posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations will conduct an oversight mission on employment conditions in Namibia’s retail and wholesale sector from 10–18 August 2026 in the Zambezi, Erongo and Kavango East regions
The mission will assess compliance with labour laws, evaluate working conditions, and engage with key stakeholders to strengthen labour standards, promote decent work, and identify policy gaps
Media are invited to cover the mission. For enquiries, contact Mr. Andreas Sheya at a.sheya@parliament.na or 081 608 8221 See less
